theme_strategy: Light & Dark Toggle (Defaulting to Warm Natural Light with Off-White and Deep Moss Green)

typography.heading_font: Plus Jakarta Sans / Playfair Display (Google Fonts link to be included)

hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-bold tracking-tight leading-[1.1]
hierarchy.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-semibold tracking-tight leading-snug
hierarchy.caption: text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.2em] font-medium text-emerald-800 dark:text-emerald-400

forbidden_fonts: Inter for main H1/H2 headings (use Plus Jakarta Sans or Playfair Display)

rules: SLA 1h overdue alert cards and SLA counter are the ONLY elements permitted to use vivid red (#DC2626). All other alerts/accents must adhere to moss green, gold, or terracotta.
Never use pure black (#000000). Always use Charcoal Tint (#141715).
Never use pure gray backgrounds. Use Off-white (#F7F6F2) for light mode.

layout_and_spacing.philosophy: Breathing Design with generous padding (2x-3x standard). Mobile-first up to Ultrawide (21:9 screen optimization).
layout_and_spacing.hero_section: Full screen high impact loop video background, max overlay opacity bg-black/40 with smooth gradient scrim for high text contrast.
layout_and_spacing.bento_grid: Asymmetric multi-span layout for services and facilities gallery.

key_features_and_flows.details: Sticky glassmorphic navbar with backdrop-blur-md bg-[#F7F6F2]/85 dark:bg-[#141715]/85. Includes logo 'Instituto Belozo', smooth scroll links (Sobre Nós, Serviços, Estrutura, Avaliação), CTA 'Agendar Avaliação', Auth Modal Trigger, and Admin View Switcher.
Autoplay muted background video loop + dark gradient overlay + headline on physical transformation & biomechanical health + primary CTA 'Agende sua Avaliação' + quick highlight pill badges.
Framer motion scroll reveal animations with staggered images of studio facilities and movement specialists, brand mission statement on individual biomechanics and personalized care.

Hover-interactive cards for Personal Training, Fisioterapia Integrativa, Reabilitação Funcional, and Avaliação Postural. Includes modal with detailed methodology and direct 'Agendar este serviço' action.
Framer Motion parallax scrolling effect on studio atmosphere photos showcasing high-end equipment, private rooms, and consultation space.
Loop video section highlighting client recovery & strength progression with interactive statistics counters (e.g. +98% taxa de recuperação sem dor, 100% atendimento individualizado).
Passo 1: Seleção de Serviço -> Passo 2: Escolha de Profissional (ou 'Qualquer profissional disponível') -> Passo 3: Calendário visual com apenas horários disponíveis e confirmação instantânea.
Login/Cadastro modal or page with inputs: Nome completo, WhatsApp (com máscara PT-BR), E-mail, Senha. Persisted local session.

key_features_and_flows.feature: Área do Cliente (Meus Agendamentos & Minha Evolução)
key_features_and_flows.details: Tabbed client portal. 'Meus Agendamentos' allows viewing, rescheduling, or canceling sessions. 'Minha Evolução' displays read-only metrics: load progression timeline, posture evolution notes, and interactive load vs. pain chart.

Admin view in moss green palette featuring: 1) Calendário dia/semana view, 2) Kanban Board (Pendente / Confirmado / Cancelado) with drag/toggle, 3) Action buttons (Confirmar, Reagendar, Cancelar), 4) SLA 1h Alert Card (vivid red highlight + countdown timer for pending requests exceeding 1 hour), 5) Occupancy rate widget (Livre vs Ocupado %), 6) Weekly schedule grid by professional, 7) Mini-prontuário (patient clinical notes, exercise loads, pain rating chart, timeline history), 8) Simulated Notifications screen (WhatsApp messages, system alerts).

motion_and_animations.hero_animations: Staggered text fade-in with slide-up motion
motion_and_animations.parallax_scrolling: useScroll and useTransform for smooth multi-depth background scrolling
motion_and_animations.cards_hover: Scale 1.02 hover elevation with subtle border stroke highlight (gold/terracotta)
motion_and_animations.wizard_transitions: AnimatePresence page slide and opacity transitions between steps 1, 2, and 3

testing_attributes.rule: Every interactive and key informational element MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a complete, responsive, single-page or multi-view React app using Javascript (.js/.jsx) with Tailwind CSS, shadcn UI components, and framer-motion.
Ensure all components strictly adhere to the moss green (#2D4A3E), off-white (#F7F6F2), dark charcoal (#141715), and gold/terracotta accent palette.
Apply vivid red (#DC2626) ONLY to the Admin SLA 1h overdue alert cards and badge counter.
Ensure video placeholders work smoothly with muted, loop, playsInline attributes and fallbacks.
Ensure data-testid attributes are present across all interactive elements for test compliance.
Provide a smooth switch between Client Landing/App view and Admin Dashboard view in the header.
